sources.label: Morphe patches for apps I use
sources.author: Navhi
patch_list: Developer options and emulators no longer block attendance.
The app stops listing the fake-GPS apps on the phone and reports location as not mocked.
Attendance no longer fails on a rooted phone.
Keep the saved point in the app
The map, the attendance form and the background service all get your saved point instead of the real fix.
Declares the Morphe Settings screen that the menu entry opens.
Show Morphe Settings in the menu
Adds the pin map, the detection switches and the about section behind a menu entry.
The modified app starts normally instead of quitting with a "changed by another party" warning.
Makes the app read your saved point for every location request and turns the background tracker off.
